detail: Atlanta did not shut players down and resting is not a concern

sources.text: Playoff schedule is 4-4-3 if the season ends March 28 and 4-3-4 if it ends April 4. They have 14 back-to-backs, and resting players is not a concern.
sources.quote: If the season ends March 28th, the Hawks play 443. Pretty good. One away from max.
